solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Determined to get result of hunt put in pot

indicators.note: put in says one piece goes inside the other, here the hunter's prize inside the word for determined

parts.note: determined, as in fixed or settled, means set
the result of a successful hunt is a kill

explanation.surface: A cook resolved to get the hunter's catch into the cooking pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A skillet is a frying pan or small cooking vessel, a kind of kitchen pot.

clue.text: Smart deal

definitions.meaning: deal is soft wood from pine or fir trees

explanation.definitionFit: The word means trim and neat, and also names a conifer whose timber is sold as deal.

clue.text: In a hole? Use your ingenuity

parts.note: taken as written
a vent is an opening or hole

explanation.surface: Stuck in a hole, you must think creatively to get out.
explanation.definitionFit: To come up with something new by cleverness is to devise it.

clue.text: One illness to suffer in isolation

indicators.note: suffer suggests the letters of the phrase are battered out of shape

explanation.surface: Someone falls ill and suffers it alone, cut off from others.
explanation.definitionFit: Being solitary and cut off from company is a state of being alone.

clue.text: There's initial demand to get second jobs

indicators.note: initial picks the first letter of the word it follows

parts.note: to demand is to ask

explanation.surface: A boss's first demand leads to a second round of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasks are pieces of work to be done, synonyms for jobs.

clue.text: Income from flat in Parisian street

indicators.note: in places the word for flat inside the French street

parts.note: rue is the French word for street
flat, as in level, means even

explanation.surface: Someone earns money by letting an apartment on a Paris street.
explanation.definitionFit: Revenue is money coming in, a synonym for income, especially of a business or state.

clue.text: Well, now

parts.note: looks like a conversational filler, but means healthy at this point after illness

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has got better from an illness is healthy again at present.

clue.text: Goodbye depression!

definitions.meaning: a valley, a dip in the land

explanation.definitionFit: It is a Latin farewell and also a poetic word for a valley.

clue.text: Narrow escape from mean girl

parts.note: near can mean stingy or mean
a miss is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: Someone narrowly escapes a spiteful young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A close call where disaster was only just avoided.

clue.text: All the same, head makes a regular appearance

parts.note: even can mean equal or level, all the same as each other
a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: Even so, the head teacher's attendance is steady.
explanation.definitionFit: Uniformity or smoothness of look is a regular appearance.

clue.text: Get ecstatic with Northern bird

parts.note: to rave is to enthuse wildly about something

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher gets thrilled at spotting a northern species.
explanation.definitionFit: The raven is a large black member of the crow family.

clue.text: An off-break

parts.note: in cricket an off-break is a spinning delivery; read instead as a break taken while off work ill

explanation.walkthrough: An off-break is a cricket ball that spins from the off side; here it means a break when you are off, unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Time away from work because you are ill is a break taken while off sick.

clue.text: Convincing vice-consul is complicated

indicators.note: complicated says the letters of the diplomat's title are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A deputy diplomat's affairs prove complex and hard to unravel.
explanation.definitionFit: Conclusive evidence settles a matter beyond doubt, so it is convincing.

clue.text: Name has to be changed? So be it

indicators.note: to be changed tells us the four letters of the given word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone agrees with a resigned shrug that their name must be altered.
explanation.definitionFit: The word said at the end of a prayer literally means let it be so.

clue.text: Where coffees are served and drunk

definitions.meaning: coffee is served in cups, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an old idiom for tipsy, and literally where hot drinks are poured.

clue.text: Untimely errors made by chairman's son

indicators.note: made by suggests the errors are constructed by reshuffling the letters that follow

parts.note: here the possessive S is kept as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: The chairman's son keeps making mistakes at the worst possible moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Anachronisms are errors in chronology, things placed in a period where they do not belong.

clue.text: What skiers may need to reach their peak

definitions.text: What skiers may need to reach their peak

parts.words: What skiers may need to reach their peak
parts.note: sounds like ambition, but literally means transport to the mountaintop

explanation.definitionFit: A cable-hung seat that carries skiers up the mountain.

clue.text: Branch is not on fire

parts.note: the opposite of on is off
to fire a gun is to shoot

explanation.surface: A tree limb is not alight after all.
explanation.definitionFit: An offshoot is a side growth or branch, of a plant or organisation.

clue.text: Appetite satisfied? One's more than enough!

definitions.meaning: having had too much of something to bear

explanation.definitionFit: It literally means a stomach filled, and figuratively more of something than one can stand.

clue.text: A treat for spectators — no support being required

definitions.meaning: read as ..., places on the terraces at no charge
standing on its own without any prop or attachment

explanation.definitionFit: Something that stands alone needs no frame or buttress, while a free stand is a gift to the crowd.

clue.text: Compensate with cosmetics?

explanation.definitionFit: Make up as a verb means to compensate; as a noun it means cosmetics.

clue.text: Inventor is done for misrepresentation

indicators.note: misrepresentation says the letters are given a false new arrangement

explanation.surface: An inventor is ruined for falsifying his claims.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Edison was the American inventor of the phonograph and a practical light bulb.

clue.text: One's QC material

definitions.meaning: a Queen's Counsel is called this because of the gown worn on taking office
a smooth fine fabric made by worms

explanation.walkthrough: QC stands for Queen's Counsel, a senior British barrister; becoming one is called taking silk.
explanation.definitionFit: Senior British barristers wear gowns of this fabric and are nicknamed after it; it is also a luxurious cloth.

clue.text: Female supporter at the match

parts.note: the match is a marriage, not a football game, and the supporter attends the bride

explanation.definitionFit: A woman who helps and accompanies the bride at a wedding.

clue.text: Daily leader studied in awe

indicators.note: leader picks out the first letter of the word before it

parts.note: to have studied a subject at university is to have read it

explanation.surface: A newspaper's editorial was perused with reverence.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread is great fear, and awe is fear mixed with wonder.

clue.text: Part of link needing a joint

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A piece of a chain needs a joint to connect it.
explanation.definitionFit: The knee is the hinge joint between thigh and lower leg.

clue.text: Insulting attack

definitions.meaning: an assault launched by an army or team

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for something rude and a noun for a military push forward.

clue.text: Consumers requiring faultless service in United States

indicators.note: in places the trimmed word inside the abbreviation
faultless means without vice, so that fault is removed from the word for service

parts.note: the full word service before trimming

explanation.surface: American consumers demand service without any flaws.
explanation.definitionFit: People who use or consume goods and services are their users.

clue.text: Everyone is in to try for the highest qualification

indicators.note: is in says the word for everyone sits inside the word for the exam

parts.note: a test is an exam by which one qualifies
everyone means all

explanation.surface: All the candidates sit an exam hoping to win the top qualification.
explanation.definitionFit: The tallest is the one rising highest, the greatest in height.

clue.text: Stand up, showing refinement — one has to receive the sweep

definitions.text: one has to receive the sweep

indicators.note: refinement suggests the letters of the phrase are reworked and improved into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone rises with dignity, ready to take a sweeping blow.
explanation.definitionFit: A small pan into which dirt is swept with a brush.
